_meta.provenance: Corpus chunks are produced by src.data_processing.ingest_pipeline.extract_and_chunk over data/sample_deal/*.txt; each row pins the chunk text by sha1 so the runner refuses to score stale labels after a chunking change. Labelled by hand by Claude (the implementing agent) reading every chunk; synthetic rows were written by the same agent, are marked syn-*, and use obviously fake people and numbers. Rows marked borderline are excluded from scoring for that label (counted separately). Split: corpus by document (dev = board deck, credit agreement, customer contracts, QoE report; test = the other five documents) so no document contributes to both; synthetic rows alternate dev/test. Single annotator - no inter-annotator agreement was measured.
_meta.guideline: A category is positive when the chunk discloses an actual exposure, open issue or operative provision of that kind affecting the company or the transaction (a pending or threatened claim, a change-of-control consent, termination right or payment, a MAC definition or condition, an indemnity cap, a required antitrust approval, a going-concern doubt or covenant breach, a dependency on one person, a revenue share held by few customers). A statement that no such issue exists (no pending litigation, no MAE has occurred, no change of control provision) is negative, as is an incidental keyword (Mac, by default, basket). Patent-infringement suits are both litigation and ip_risk.
_meta.category_notes: The ten categories of RISK_PATTERNS are kept: none is fully redundant. litigation and ip_risk overlap on patent suits but ip_risk also covers open-source and assignment gaps. The corpus has no material_adverse_change, financial_distress or environmental_liability positives; those are covered only by synthetic rows.

synthetic.text: The Company is not a party to any pending or, to its knowledge, threatened litigation, arbitration or governmental proceeding.
On March 3, 2024, Helix Corp filed suit against the Company in the U.S. District Court for the District of Delaware alleging breach of a supply agreement and seeking damages of $12 million.
Since the Balance Sheet Date, no Material Adverse Effect has occurred and no event has occurred that would reasonably be expected to have a Material Adverse Effect.

"Material Adverse Effect" means any event, change or effect that is materially adverse to the business, financial condition or results of operations of the Company, excluding changes in general economic conditions.
Buyer's obligation to close is conditioned on no MAC having occurred with respect to the Company between signing and closing; Buyer may terminate if a MAC occurs.
The sales team is equipped with Mac laptops running macOS, and IT support is outsourced to a managed service provider.
Administrators can change the default settings of the analytics dashboard; by default, usage data is retained for 90 days.
The Company received a notice of default from its lenders on January 12 after breaching the minimum liquidity covenant, and has entered into a 60-day forbearance agreement.
The auditors' report includes an explanatory paragraph expressing substantial doubt about the Company's ability to continue as a going concern.
The auditors issued an unqualified opinion on the FY2023 financial statements and did not identify any material weakness in internal control over financial reporting.
Customer concentration: the largest customer represents 38% of revenue and the top three customers together account for 61%.
Our largest customer, Orion Retail, accounted for 41% of FY2023 revenue, and its contract is terminable for convenience on 90 days' notice.
Revenue is highly diversified: no single customer accounts for more than 2% of annual revenue and the top twenty customers account for 14%.
The lease for the Reno distribution centre expires in June 2025; the Company expects to renew on similar terms.
synthetic.note: lease expiry - not a listed risk category

synthetic.text: Patent expiry: U.S. Patent No. 8,112,334, which covers the compression method in the flagship product, expires in March 2025, after which competitors may freely use the technique.
The Phase I environmental site assessment identified soil contamination from historical petroleum storage at the Gary, Indiana plant; estimated remediation cost is $2.1 million.
The Company's operations are office-based; it holds no environmental permits, handles no hazardous materials, and no environmental claims have been asserted against it.
The Elkhart facility is on the EPA National Priorities List and the Company has been named a potentially responsible party under CERCLA for groundwater cleanup.
The FTC issued a civil investigative demand in November 2023 concerning the Company's subscription auto-renewal practices; the investigation is ongoing.
No governmental authority has commenced or, to the Company's knowledge, threatened any investigation, inquiry or enforcement action against the Company.
The acquisition requires clearance from the European Commission; given a combined share of about 35% in the EEA, counsel expects an in-depth Phase II review.
The founder and CEO personally manages the three largest customer relationships and has neither an employment agreement nor a non-compete.
The Company has a deep management bench, and documented succession plans exist for every executive role.
Upon a change of control of the licensee, the licensor may terminate this licence on 30 days' written notice.
None of the Company's material contracts contains a change of control, anti-assignment or similar provision that would be triggered by the Merger.
If the Company undergoes a Change in Control, all unvested options held by the Chief Financial Officer accelerate and vest in full.
Seller shall indemnify and hold harmless Buyer from any Losses arising from pre-Closing taxes, subject to a cap equal to 10% of the Purchase Price.
The escrow agent shall hold $5 million of the Purchase Price for 18 months as security for Seller's indemnification obligations under Article IX.
Shoppers can add items to a basket and check out using saved payment methods; the average basket size grew 8% in FY2023.
Headcount grew to 420 employees during the year, and the Company has no collective bargaining agreements.
A former distributor has threatened to commence arbitration over approximately $800,000 of unpaid commissions; no claim has yet been filed.
The settlement agreement with Quantel was fully performed in 2021, all claims were released, and no obligations remain outstanding.
The on-premise product distributed to customers links a GPL-licensed library, and the Company has not complied with the licence's source-code disclosure obligations.
A competitor has sent a letter alleging that the flagship product infringes three of its patents and demanding a royalty of 5% of net sales.
All current and former employees and contractors have signed invention assignment agreements, and the Company owns all intellectual property used in its business.
Covenant compliance: net leverage was 4.8x at Q4 against a 4.5x maximum; the Company obtained a one-time waiver from its lenders.
The Company prepaid $40 million of its term loan in FY2023 and has no debt maturities before 2029.
The pricing algorithm is maintained by a single data scientist, and no other employee has access to or understands the model code.
Buyer's acquisition of more than 50% of the voting shares will be a Change of Control under the Indenture, requiring the Company to offer to repurchase the notes at 101%.
The merger or consolidation of two wholly owned subsidiaries in 2022 was an internal reorganisation with no effect on third-party contracts.
The top 5 customer contracts were renegotiated in 2023 at higher prices, with no change to their terms.
At the current burn rate the Company has approximately four months of cash runway, and management is seeking bridge financing from existing investors.
Mac Duffie, Vice President of Sales, relocated to the Austin office in the second quarter.
The CEO's and CFO's employment agreements provide for severance of twice base salary on a termination without cause within 12 months following a change of control.
Environmental matters: the Company leases office space only and does not store, handle or dispose of hazardous materials.
